ns2:section.sectionText: This class combines an intensive weekend model (2 weekends, 8 hrs/day) of face to face meetings with online modules in Illinois Compass. Face-to-face class will meet on the following Saturdays and Sundays: 2/18-19 and 4/1-2 from 9:00-5:00 in Room 2030 with time for lunch.
